Controls.Follow: Make selected tokens follow the hovered or targeted token

HUD.Follow: Follow the hovered or targeted token
HUD.Stop: Stop this token from following (Shift-click also stops)

Follow.Name: Follow hovered or targeted token
Follow.Hint: Selected tokens begin following the token under the pointer or your current target.

Stop.Name: Stop following
Stop.Hint: Selected tokens stop following their current leader.

MovementStyle.Name: Follower movement style
MovementStyle.Hint: Trail places companions behind the leader. Formation preserves their relative positions.

CopyFollowers.Name: Copy followers with the leader
CopyFollowers.Hint: When a leader token is copied and pasted, copy its followers too, preserve their formation, and reconnect them to the new leader.

Snap.Name: Snap followers to grid
Snap.Hint: Place follower destinations on the nearest grid position.

Collisions.Name: Respect movement walls
Collisions.Hint: Do not move a follower when its destination would cross a movement-blocking wall.

Orient.Name: Face movement direction
Orient.Hint: Rotate following tokens to face the direction they move.

ManualMove.Name: Stop when follower is moved manually
ManualMove.Hint: Moving a follower by hand removes its relationship with the leader.

Combat.Name: Behavior during combat
Combat.Hint: Choose whether relationships pause, are removed, or continue while combat is active.

Teleport.Name: Stop following on long teleports
Teleport.Hint: Remove the relationship when the leader makes a very large movement within a Scene. Cross-Scene copy is handled separately.

TeleportDistance.Name: Teleport distance
TeleportDistance.Hint: Scene distance at which a movement counts as a teleport.

Notifications.SelectFollowersAndLeader: Select one or more follower tokens, then hover over or target their leader.
Notifications.ChooseDifferentLeader: Hover over or target a different token to use as the leader.
Notifications.NoPermission: You do not have permission to manage every selected token.
Notifications.CycleSkipped: A token was skipped because that relationship would create a follower loop.
Notifications.ManualDetached: {name} stopped following because it was moved manually.
Notifications.TeleportDetached: Followers were detached because the leader teleported.
Notifications.CopyPrepared: Adding {count} follower token(s) to this paste.
Notifications.CopyComplete: Reconnected {count} follower token(s) to their copied leader.
